title: The Hidden Trap Wrecking Your Fulfillment
description: The Hidden Trap Wrecking Your Fulfillment
transcript: You start to close people that may or may not be dream clients now in the beginning this doesn't seem to be an issue because you're closing the deals you collect that cash up front and you're all Humpty Dory the problem with it is that as your client success team or you start the fulfillment process you start to realize oh, okay, this person's not exactly who we serve we gotta do this few additional things that we don't typically do and we gotta kind of train them on the social thing they they don't already know and so your client says us to do maybe 20% additional work right and so maybe that's not a big deal right? You made some cash 20% additional work not a big deal but the problem is when that starts happening at scale now another one of those clients comes in and another one and now you're talking about five 10 15, 20 30 clients coming in a month where they're outside of what your typical scope is and now your client success team starts to really feel that burden your fulfillment team starts to really feel that burden you think oh, we gotta hire more service people in order to service them but the problem with that is that you're missing the most powerful tool you have which is the ability at the time of the close or in your marketing to make sure that you're only closing your Dream client because those clients are the ones that complain the least, ask you the least amount of questions and typically need the least amount of work.
